clips.caption:
A caller once phoned a radio show just to thank Kevin Trudeau for the best business decision he ever made.

500 people applied for the same Wall Street job he wanted. He used memory training to learn all 1,500 NYSE companies and their stock symbols cold.

Executives started pulling coworkers in just to watch him recall it live.

He got the job. Three promotions followed. A powerful memory, he says, is worth real money - a weak one is quietly costing you some.

What would one remembered detail do for your next interview?

#kevintrudeau #memory #careeradvice #jobinterview #success #wealthmindset

Kevin Trudeau says he once tested his memory against a casino, on purpose.

Single deck blackjack, no gimmicks: he tracked every card already played, calculated exactly what remained in the deck, and hit on a 17 when the math said to, against basic strategy.

An hour later he'd made $250,000. He says it's all documented, all caught on the casino's own videotape.

The edge wasn't luck. It was knowing what was left in the deck before the dealer did.

What would a sharper memory be worth in your work?

#kevintrudeau #memory #blackjack #casino #mindset #wealthmindset
